widget.name: IronCalc SpreadUI
widget.description: Fast, practical IronCalc spreadsheet UI connected to Mendix data.

property.caption: Rows
property.description: Optional Mendix list data source used to populate spreadsheet rows.

property.caption: Columns
property.description: Ordered spreadsheet columns. Duplicate or empty headers are made unique automatically.

property.caption: Header
property.description: Column heading shown in the first spreadsheet row.

property.caption: Value attribute
property.description: Mendix attribute read into this column and optionally written back on Save.

property.caption: Formula template
property.description: Optional IronCalc formula. Use {row} for the 1-based spreadsheet row, for example =C{row}*D{row}.

property.caption: Write changes back
property.description: Write edited cells back to editable Mendix attributes when Save is pressed. Formula columns are never written back.

property.caption: Width
property.description: Initial column width in pixels, clamped to a practical range.

property.caption: Workbook state
property.description: Optional String attribute that persists the complete IronCalc workbook as base64.

property.caption: When no data is configured
property.description: Show a useful sample workbook or start with an empty workbook.

property.caption: Maximum rows
property.description: Maximum Mendix rows loaded in one batch. Values are clamped between 1 and 10000.

property.caption: Title
property.description: SpreadUI heading.

property.defaultValue: Edit, calculate, persist, and reuse Mendix data in one workspace.
property.caption: Description
property.description: Short guidance displayed under the title.

property.caption: Height
property.description: Spreadsheet height in pixels, clamped between 320 and 1600.

property.caption: Theme
property.description: Visual theme for SpreadUI and the IronCalc workbook.

property.caption: Read only
property.description: Hide IronCalc editing controls and prevent Mendix write-back.

property.caption: Workbook name
property.description: Name embedded in newly created workbooks and downloaded files.

property.caption: Sheet name
property.description: Name of the initial data sheet.

property.caption: Locale
property.description: IronCalc locale. Supported values are en, en-GB, fr, de, it, and es; regional variants fall back to their supported language.

property.caption: Time zone
property.description: IANA time zone used by IronCalc, such as UTC or Asia/Seoul.

property.caption: After save
property.description: Optional action executed after workbook persistence and Mendix attribute write-back finish.
